course_name_original: Cálculo, Construcción y Ensayo de Máquinas
course_name_en: Calculation, Construction and Testing of Machines
prerequisites: Passing previous subjects: Theory of Mechanisms and Machines, Physics I and II and Advanced Mathematics.
Prior knowledge: Kinematics and Dynamics of Machines and Mechanisms.
Engineering materials, their properties and applications.

learning_outcomes.text: Be able to calculate, design and lay the mechanical foundations for the construction of machines.
Integrate the basic concepts of machine design, including mechanical and materials engineering, and failure prevention under static and variable load in the design process itself.
Know the functional characteristics of the main types of mechanical elements.
Relate fundamental concepts to the practical specification of components.

syllabus_topics: BLOCK I. Static failure and fatigue design and prevention
Topic 1.- Static design and dimensioning of Machine elements.
1.1 Stresses and fatigue strength in Shafts, bolts, bars.
1.2 Static failure theories. TENM, TECM, Von Mises, C-Mohor
Topic 2.-Fatigue design and prevention in Machine elements.
2.1 Stresses and fatigue strength. SN curves
2.2 Fatigue failure theories. Goodman, Soderberg, Herber, Marin.
2.4 Programming in Excel, Matlab and Python.
4.1 Design of Shafts and Transmission Shafts
BLOCK III. Mechanical vibrations of 1 and N degrees of freedom. Isolation of mechanical vibrations
Topic 6.- Mechanical Vibrations 1 degree of freedom.
6.5 Programming in Matlab and Python symbolic and numerical calculation.
Topic 7.- Vibrations N degrees of freedom.
9.3 Vibration modes in a shaft and critical speeds
assessment_rules: It is necessary to obtain 5 out of 10 points in each problem.
